themes.twistDescription: Twist B (Letter spacing injection) at intensity 4: added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.08em. Replaced Sora with Plus Jakarta Sans, Fragment Mono with JetBrains Mono, Inter Display with Manrope. All woff2 removed; fonts load via Google Fonts CDN.

Twist C (Easing curve swap) at intensity 4: replaced primary ease-in-out with springy cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) throughout Apple Mac's nav ribbons, chapter items, and modal fades. Bare ease values upgraded to ease-in-out.
Twist B (Gap value scaling) at intensity 3: expanded all columnGap and rowGap values by x1.4 across all responsive breakpoints. 2em → 2.8em, 1.11111vw → 1.55556vw, 24px → 33.6px.
Twist D (Button padding shift), wider, intensity 4: added +16px horizontal padding to button (10px → 26px). Only elements.button modified.
Twist E (Focus state enhancement) at intensity 3: added explicit focus states with outlineWidth: 2px and outlineOffset: 2px to all interactive elements. No color values modified.
Twist E (Item spacing change), wider, intensity 4: increased itemSpacing from 57.5px to 71.5px (+14px). Lenclume's centered-logo gallery nav with expanded link breathing room.

Twist A (Kinetic shift) applied to the brand manifesto sections paragraph: rewritten to foreground the pulse and momentum of the typographic mass as it surges across the viewport, rather than describing these sections as visual breathing rooms.
